sources.snippet: DistilBERT is a lightweight version of BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) developed by Hugging Face using knowledge distillation. It retains most of BERT's language understanding capabilities while reducing model size, memory usage, and computational requirements, making it suitable for resource-constrained devices ...
